cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Prove We’re Close
cards.instruction: Get someone to take a social or emotional risk that demonstrates trust in the connection.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come to the reunion holding my hand. We'll make one clear entrance; no separate arrivals for people to misread.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They still think we're just friends.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll handle the introduction. Your name first, then 'my partner.' We don't leave that information to guesses.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Last time someone asked, you let go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're right. This time I'll say it before anyone asks. Keep hold while I introduce you, please; I want us to get through the whole sentence together.
